conclusion.reason: The audited replay11 evidence contains failure-stage and cleanup metadata but no serialized Chromium child policy, runtime-generated argv, replay-time Framework identity, or build provenance. The audited runners define the outer Seatbelt wrapper and synthetic launch arguments but do not capture the Chromium-generated child profile. Existing static bundle identity and pinned Chromium source references therefore cannot recover the replay-time exact profile or establish a unique root cause.

limitations: This is a static audit of the listed repository evidence, runners, and preserved bundle identity record; it is not a new packaged Electron replay.
The result does not prove that no unlisted external artifact could contain the profile; it records that the audited project artifacts do not contain or reconstruct it.
Obtaining exact runtime profile and replay-time binary provenance would require a separately authorized instrumented packaged run or equivalent preserved trace.
No OS-level per-app egress control was configured or evaluated in this audit.
